🏃🩲 Blaze through life without a care in the world with the Streaking Kittens Expansion! Why worry about that Exploding Kitten card you just drew when you have a Streaking Kitten card in your hand? Now, that fiery kitty is gonna be someone else’s problem… 

[b]With five new card flows and three new decks[/b], Streaking Kittens brings more mayhem to your favourite cat-themed explosive card game! 

[h3]New cards:[/h3]
[b]Swap Top and Bottom[/b] – Sit down for this shocker: this card swaps the top and bottom card of the draw pile. Gasp! 
[b]Mark[/b] – With this card, you force a player to reveal a card in their hand…and keep it revealed!
[b]Garbage Collection[/b] – Everyone chucks a card from their hand back into the draw pile. Give it a shuffle too, obviously. 
[b]Catomic Bomb[/b] – Send all the Exploding Kitten cards to the top of the draw pile, then end your turn.

notes.title: 💣 Let the Chaos Be Shared: EK2 Content Sharing FAQ
notes.notes:
[h2]Content sharing is coming to Exploding Kittens 2!💥[/h2]
What does that mean, we hear you cry! Well, basically, it means that you can share your expansions with buddies who don't own them when you're the host, so you can all enjoy a game together with those brand-spanking-new cards.

We’ve put together this FAQ to clear up all your questions and help you get the most out of your shared chaos sessions.

[h3]How do I play Exploding Kittens® 2 with my friends?[/h3]
It’s easy to play Exploding Kittens® 2 with your friends! 
[olist]
[*] Click “PLAY”.
[*] Click “PLAY WITH FRIENDS” (make sure you’re signed into Bubble!).
[*] Click “CREATE A GAME” to host a game.
[*] Share the room code found on the top right of your screen with your friends. Alternatively, click “INVITE FRIEND” to invite a Bubble or Steam friend directly.
[*] If you’re the one receiving a code, follow steps 1 and 2, then enter the room code into the “JOIN GAME” box.
[/olist]
Everyone needs to own a copy of the Exploding Kittens® 2 base game to play. 

[h3]Can we play the expansions together? 
[/h3]Yes, you can play any Exploding Kittens® 2 expansion in “PLAY WITH FRIENDS” mode.

[h3]What if one of us doesn’t own the expansion? Can they still join?
[/h3]Yes! So long as the person who owns the expansion hosts the game, they can share the expansion with their friends in “PLAY WITH FRIENDS” mode. All you need to do is make sure the expansion owner is the one who clicks “CREATE GAME”. This is called “content sharing”. 

[h3]Which expansions does this work with?  
[/h3]All of them!

[h3]Can I use content sharing online with random players/others or just with friends?
[/h3]You can only share your expansions via “PLAY WITH FRIENDS”. Anyone who enters your room code can share your expansions for that match. You cannot share content via “PLAY WITH OTHERS”.

[h3]Can I use this with cross-play?
[/h3]Yes, you can!
[h2]_____________
[/h2]

While we’re here, we thought we’d also answer some common questions about the expansions themselves:

[h3]What content is in the different expansions? 
[/h3]Each expansion comes jam-packed with new content! As a general outline, this includes: 
[list]
[*] New card designs 
[*] New card abilities 
[*] New decks [/list]
[h3]Can the expansions be mixed together? 
[/h3]Exploding Kittens 2 features multiple decks that combine its expansions. For example, the Attack of the Attacks deck uses cards from Exploding Kittens 2 and Streaking Kittens. 

[h3]💬 Got More Questions?[/h3]
We’ve covered the big stuff, but if anything’s still unclear, drop your questions in the comments and we'll do our best to keep the answers (and chaos) coming! 🐱

notes.title: WHAT'S NEXT FOR EXPLODING KITTENS® 2?
notes.notes:
Greetings, Furballs!

First of all, we want to thank you all for taking the time to play Exploding Kittens® 2 and sharing your thoughts. You may have noticed that it’s been suspiciously quiet over at the Exploding Kittens Emporium the last few weeks. We’ve been sending out in-game updates full-throttle, patching and adding your most-requested features at such a pace that, frankly, we haven’t had time to sit down and have a nice catch-up with you all. 

[h3]Fixing our fur[/h3]

If you’ve been playing Exploding Kittens 2 over the last few weeks, no doubt you’ve noticed a hefty number of improvements and fixes. We’re going to take a moment to brag about some of them here: 
[list]
[*] The game now remembers your customisation settings.
[*] We sped up the animations and certain game moments. You have things to do, we get it. 
[*] Made Nopes better by adding a Nope button, so now you can execute a speedy Nope. Nope, nope, nope…
[*] Added the ability to tap cards to play them, rather than dragging them. Team Tap or Team Drag…?
[*] Gave the scoring system an overhaul.
[*] Added action timers to online games. Again, YOU HAVE PLACES TO BE, RIGHT? 
[*] Sent the AI to AI school to become even smarter. You’re in for a real challenge now! 
[*] General bug fixes. We’re getting our flea treatments regularly, like good kitties.
[/list]
We pride ourselves on creating top-quality games, and that means taking it on the chin when players tell us they feel something is missing. It also means doing something about it, and we’re sure you’ll agree that that’s exactly what we’ve done. 

[h3]BUT WAIT, THERE’S MORE[/h3]

We’re not stopping there either! The boffins in the Emporium have been cooking up a storm, and they’ve not only added a bunch of Quality of Life updates, but possibly the most fan-requested feature in Exploding Kittens history…

[b]That’s right – CONTENT SHARING IS COMING, FOLKS! [/b]

Get ready to be the MVP of your squad. If you own any of the Exploding Kittens 2 expansions, you can now share them with your buddies in “PLAY WITH FRIENDS” mode. Even if they don’t own the same expansions, they can join you in your game. Sharing is caring, after all! 

[h3]AND EVEN MORE! [/h3]

You thought we were done? You thought wrong, buddy. 

Along with all of this, we’ve also nearly finished production of the next expansion – STREAKING KITTENS! 

We’re adding the final polish, trimming its paw pads and brushing its coat. It’s almost ready to get zoomies and bound all over your screen! 

Keep your eyes peeled, folks – we’ll have a release date announcement in the next 2 weeks! 

[b]So…who’s up for a round of Exploding Kittens 2?[/b]
Whether you’re a dedicated player, new to the game or maybe haven’t logged in for a little while, now’s the time to dive back into the chaos and tell us what YOU think of the recent changes, fixes, patches and updates! 

Play Exploding Kittens 2 today, then tell us what you think on Steam or head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/4x5muwbafT]Discord server[/url] to chat with the team directly! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2999030/Exploding_Kittens_2/

notes.title: Santa Claws Visits Exploding Kittens® 2!
notes.notes:
The squad down at the Exploding Kittens® 2 Emporium got an email from Santa Claus. Apparently, you’re all on the naughty list this year. Something about setting Bear-o-dactyls on people. 

Luckily for you, the kitty version of St Nick, Santa Claws, loves that sort of misbehaviour. So he’s put together a special pack in thanks for all your mischief this year – the Santa Claws pack! 

[h3]🎁 WRAP YOURSELF UP, YOU ABSOLUTE GIFT[/h3]
You get a choice of two style-conscious outfits in the Santa Claws pack. 

First up, remind everyone that the true gift is you with the Wrapped Up outfit! Or, if you really, really need to see some snow this Christmas, pick the Snow Globe outfit. Snowflakes RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOUR EYES AT ALL TIMES. 

[h3]🎄 FLING YOURSELF UNDER THE TREE[/h3]
Once you’re wrapped up or living your best snow-globe life, it’s time to dive into the new location – Under the Tree. 

A lot can be said about the health and safety elements of setting up a highly flammable game under a highly flammable tree, but worry not! Everything’s digital! No trees shall burn during a game of Exploding Kittens® 2. 

[h3]❄️ SEND YOUR SEASON’S GREETINGS[/h3]
Spread the festive cheer – or seasonal salt – with the Santa Claws emoji pack! Listen, if you’re going to spam emojis during the holiday season, you can at least make them merry and jolly. 


[h3]🃏 DECK YOUR DECK WITH DECORATIONS [/h3]
Deck the halls, deck yourself (no wait, don’t do that), deck your deck with boughs of holly, fa la la la la, la la la laaa~ 

The Santa Claws card back is the equivalent of putting an ugly Christmas sweater on your cards. Hideous, but somehow, everyone likes you more when you’re wearing one. 


[b]And just like that, you’re all Christmassy and cheerful this winter! Want to join in the festive fun? Play with the Santa Claws pack when it releases soon![/b]

With the Mystic Mayhem Pack, you’ll be kitted out in ghoulish style – frighten everyone in the game, including yourself! 

[h3]👻 VISIT MADAME BEATRICE…
[/h3]364 days of the year, Beatrice’s dining room table hosts nothing scarier than her reheated shepherd’s pie. But on Halloween, her entire abode transforms to reveal the truth – Beatrice isn’t just any elderly lady. She’s got psychic powers! Honest! 

Don’t believe us? Go to the new location, Madame Beatrice’s House, and find out for yourself. 

[h3]🔮 …OR B̵̤̮̫̋͊̽̉È̶͍̿́͝Ç̴̛͇̀O̷̻̯̾͝M̶̨̢̲̲̈́Ḙ̸͖̎̐ ̴̢̰̫̌̂ͅH̸̻͈͛̈́̀͘E̴̢͈̯̙̐̈́͝R̶̥̜̪̊̂̅͠!
[/h3]
Think you can do a better job of rattling tables and sensing auras than Madame Beatrice? Then do the job yourself with the eerie Madame Beatrice outfit! Swathe yourself in the psychic’s silks and light some incense to really get in the mood. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074912/845d18502bc791465d5bee15cd4309b04cb7962e.png[/img]
[h3]🥣 WHY IS THERE NO CAULDRON EMOJI?
[/h3]
In the year 2024, we still don’t have a cauldron emoji. All that aside, if you’re not terribly fond of the idea of dressing in an oracle’s garments, why not fling yourself in a bubbling cauldron, merge with the horrors within, undergo a hideous-yet-rather-cute metamorphosis and emerge in your new, gooey form as the Cauldron Creature? 

We have an outfit for that! 

[h3]🕯️ DELIVER SICK BURNS
[/h3]
Now you’re all dressed up and ready to scare the neighbours on a night where it’s actually expected (seriously, stop hiding in their bins and bursting out every Thursday, Clive), it’s time to talk the talk too. The Mystic Mayhem emoji pack is on hand to illuminate your emotions for all to see. 

[h3]🌚 SKULK IN THE SHADOWS
[/h3]
Complete the look with the Mystic Mayhem card backs. They’re dark, spooky, and definitely not just a phase, Mom. 


Sure, the Mystic Mayhem Pack is ideal for Halloween, but there’s no reason for the scary fun to end there. With this additional content, you can creep it real all year round – in the cool way! Not the “call the police” way. 

[i]🤫 (Hey, you. We have a message from the spirit realm. It says, “Go check our social media channels for a delightfully ghastly Exploding Kittens® 2 [b]giveaway[/b]…” So cryptic. So mysterious. What could it mean?) [/i]

notes.title: Four Hecking Good Reasons to Play Exploding Kittens® 2
notes.notes:
The most sparkly new digital version of Exploding Kittens® is here! We call it…EXPLODING KITTENS® 2. 

Sure, it’s got kittens, explosions, ninjas, explosions, Bear-o-dactyls and explosions, but why else should you play Exploding Kittens® 2? 

Glad you asked. 

[b]Here are four more excellent reasons to play this chaotic digital card game with your friends:[/b]

[h3]🤖 FIGHT THE AI[/h3]
If the newspapers are to be believed – AND WHY WOULDN’T THEY BE – AI is going to take over the world. Do your bit to fight back! Our single player mode allows you to battle expertly crafted AI opponents. No pressure, but every time you lose against the AI opponents, another supermarket checkout becomes an out-of-order self-service checkout screeching about unexpected items in the bagging area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074912/2917498dd981ea96a6683a7ad473389ca1f6e219.png[/img]

[h3]🚫 COUNTER THEIR SHENANIGANS WITH A NOPE[/h3]
Absolutely ruin your opponent’s day with a well-placed Nope. You get a Nope, and you get a Nope, and you get a Nope, and – 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074912/0eb4e314fd7844747e9092f025e1a57b891677df.png[/img]

[h3]👗 THE PRETTIEST AVATAR IN ALL THE LAND[/h3]
You’re not going into battle dressed like that. 

Luckily, we have plenty of Outfits available for you to dress up your Avatar before diving into a game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074912/eb8d93d4a55734f076482c2c71b3fec2fd681a0f.png[/img]

[h3]🎮 A GAME MODE FOR EVERY OCCASION[/h3]
We have a wonderful selection of game modes: Play With Myself, Play With Friends and Play With Strangers. Yes, all three of those mode names passed our editors and quality assurance team. Why? What’s wrong with them? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074912/283b143671c1cc733ea4c63bc1daa487df461155.png[/img][b]These and many more await you in EXPLODING KITTENS® 2! Go download it and join the carnage today![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.10
notes.notes:
We wanted to thank you all for the incredible support during the launch of Exploding Kittens® 2! We’ve been gathering up your feedback, and with your help, we’ve been able to deploy several fixes already.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue where AI sometimes wouldn't use a defuse when they had one.
- Fixed some Multiplayer stability issues that prevented joining a new lobby.
- Fixed an issue where the Leaderboards would show incorrectly.

And that’s not all! We’re working hard to get more fixes out the door as soon as possible, namely:
- Fixing the infamous Shuffle lock in Multiplayer.
- Adjust the speed of gameplay/animations.

Developing games isn't easy, but your passion really keeps us going. Thank you for your patience as we continue working to make this game purrfect – or explode trying!

Please keep reporting any issues or suggestions you may have to help us further improve the game via the Community Hub, Discord or help@marmalademail.com.
